availability_offers.note: Historical engagement: the 2024 GXO multi-year RaaS contract (Digit 4 per Agility, 2026-09-15); no outright unit purchase was offered. Current channel (owner decision D4, 2026-10-23): contact sales via agilityrobotics.com/sales ('Get Digit in your facility'), reached from both 'Deploy Digit' and 'Deploy Digit 5' buttons. That page names no generation, transaction type, price or country, so this offer is generation-unspecified: the RAAS transaction and US scope rest on the 2024 GXO contract. Digit 5 is in development (early access expected H1 2027, general availability by end-2027, per Agility 2026-09-15) and none of its specifications or availability are recorded on this record.

use_case_fits.limitations: Available only as a service, not for outright purchase.

use_case_fits.notes: Editorial judgement. Autonomous tote handling and material movement carry over to line feeding and intralogistics inside factories.
use_case_fits.limitations: The recorded deployment is in warehouse logistics; no manufacturing deployment is recorded. Tote handling only, not assembly work. Available as a service, not for purchase.

spec_caveats.text: Agility Robotics states 'There are 28 degrees of freedom and quite a few sensors' (https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/crossing-sim2real-gap-with-isaaclab). Stated in Agility's 2024-10-31 article about 'our humanoid robot Digit', before the Digit 5 announcement (2026-09-15).

Agility Robotics states 'we can teleop Digit to perform the same task numerous times' (https://www.agilityrobotics.com/content/agility-and-ai). Agility article of 2026-03-16 (before Digit 5); Agility's FAQ says teleoperation is used during initial site setup.
